data.notes: May 2027 is still early on the confirmed calendar, with the strongest verified picks so far coming from touring pop, Latin, psych-pop and electronic-leaning rock rather than late-announced club nights.

events.title: Niall Horan
events.summary: Niall Horan is confirmed by Ticketmaster for Palacio de los Deportes on Friday, May 7, 2027 at 8:00 PM. This is the first night of his Mexico City run.

events.title: Niall Horan
events.summary: Ticketmaster confirms a second Niall Horan date at Palacio de los Deportes on Saturday, May 8, 2027 at 8:00 PM. The extra night signals strong arena-level demand in the city.

events.title: Jay Wheeler
events.summary: Puerto Rican singer Jay Wheeler is confirmed at Pepsi Center on Sunday, May 16, 2027 at 8:00 PM. The show brings a Latin urban and romantic R&B-leaning headline date to the month.

events.title: La Casa Azul at Sonorama México 27
events.summary: Elefant Records lists La Casa Azul for Sonorama Mexico 27 at Estadio Fray Nano in Mexico City on Saturday, May 1, 2027. The booking adds Spanish indie-pop to the month's early confirmed festival calendar.

events.title: Illusion Festival 2027 by DEM Records
events.summary: Psychedelic electronic/techno festival by DEM Records confirmed for 15–16 May in Mexico City; venue details appear TBA.

events.title: Hipnosis Presenta: The Limiñanas
events.summary: Fever lists Hipnosis Presenta: The Limiñanas at Foro Indie Rocks! on Friday, May 21, 2027, with doors at 7:00 PM. The French duo's show is pitched around garage rock, psychedelia and retro pop textures.

events.title: HENGE en CDMX
events.summary: HENGE is listed for Foro 28 on Saturday, May 22, 2027 at 9:00 PM. The event description frames the UK band as a psychedelic, space-techno and krautrock live act.

events.title: Carolina Ross — Oasis Rossa
events.summary: Ticketmaster confirms Carolina Ross' Oasis Rossa show at Lunario del Auditorio Nacional on Thursday, May 27, 2027 at 8:30 PM. The Lunario page identifies the show as regional mexicano.
